name: cGZMessageQueue::cGZMessageQueue

Test GZMessageQueue_ConstructDestruct compares the fresh state (list self-linked, size, lock count, the signal's event and manual-reset word, count) and the import log (CreateEventA); every script test also starts from it. Mutants (both queues, lane LR): 49/49 killed.

name: cGZMessageQueue::~cGZMessageQueue
notes: Hooked (cGZMessageQueue_Destruct): our destructor on the object (signal, lock, list freed in reverse member order). Test GZMessageQueue_ConstructDestruct: queues of 0-4 messages, built by our adapter or by the original constructor (the server member's route), destroyed by 0xc74cea vs ours; the freed block sizes and the CloseHandle log compared.

notes: Decrements above 1, else deletes through the virtual destructor and returns 0. GZMessageQueue_Script (decrements) and GZMessageQueue_ReleaseDeletes (0-3 messages, 0-2 AddRefs: results, freed blocks, CloseHandle). In effect through callers (standalone shape).
